name: Captions + Voice
description: Voiceover with bold word-by-word TikTok captions over animated gradients, photos or b-roll. The all-rounder for tips, news and opinions.
prompt_hint: Conversational voiceover, one idea per scene. Scene 1 states the payoff in under 3 seconds. Use short onScreenText headlines (2-5 words) that reinforce, not repeat, the narration. Prefer image/video visuals when the user provides files, otherwise gradient or emoji.
